newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia state transport firms profit up 145 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia state transport firms profit up 145 pct.

text.p: JAKARTA, - Indonesia said on Monday its 17 state-owned transportation firms posted total profit of 814.20 billion rupiah on total sales of 7.99 trillion rupiah in 1996.
Dhanutirto said in a statement to a parliamentary commission that 1996 profit was up 145.16 percent against 1995 profit of 332.11 billion rupiah.
He said the 1996 total sales rose to 7.99 trillion rupiah from 7.06 trillion rupiah in 1995.
Dhanutirto said he expected the 17 firms to post profit of 1.08 trillion rupiah in 1997 on total sales of 8.7 trillion rupiah.
The 17 firms included four firms involved in land transportation, 10 in sea transportation and three in air transport, he said.
Dhanutirto did not say whether the profit was net or gross. $=2,372.50
